description: This file contains post-build scripts for a software project, primarily handling static asset copying, alias file generation, and orchestrating several build steps related to bundled plugin runtime dependencies.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of destination paths for static extension assets based on the static asset definitions.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies static extension asset files from source to destination, creating directories as needed, and issues warnings if source files are missing.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Generates alias files in the distribution directory for runtime assets matching a specific naming pattern.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Runs the collection of build-step scripts including copying assets, generating aliases, and staging runtime dependencies.
